statement: An FA engineer starts the working day from a brief that states decisions, recommendations, unknowns and handled items, each traceable to a cited source.
quote: The goal is complete when an FA engineer starts the working day from a brief that states what needs a decision, what is recommended, what is unknown and what was already handled, and every statement in that brief is traceable to a cited source.

hints.falsifier: A brief statement has no resolvable cited source, or one of the four item states is missing from the brief.

statement: Phase one is bounded to triage of a failed drive and its symptom for one product family at one site over an English corpus.
quote: Phase one covers triage of a failed hard disk drive and its reported symptom for one product family at one site over an English corpus.

statement: Completion is defined by the finite WBPR, never by continued search for a better assistant.
quote: Completion is defined by this finite description, not by continued search for a better assistant.

statement: Improvements discovered after acceptance become successor goals unless they falsify a WBPR proposition.
quote: Improvements discovered after acceptance become successor goals unless they falsify a proposition of this WBPR.

statement: The WD FA bounded future is accepted by the operator and then by a Western Digital sponsor.
quote: This bounded future awaits operator acceptance and then acceptance by a Western Digital sponsor.

hints.acceptance: An operator acceptance record and a Western Digital sponsor acceptance record name the exact wbpr.md digest.

statement: The FA engineer owns every consequential disposition of a failure case.
quote: The FA engineer owns every consequential disposition of a failure case.

statement: A senior FA engineer may credit a recurring judgment as a named rule.
quote: A senior FA engineer may credit a recurring judgment as a named rule.

statement: The FA assistant proposes rankings, explanations and next actions and holds no authority to act.
quote: The FA assistant proposes rankings, explanations and next actions but holds no authority to act.

statement: An independent verifier checks every brief claim against its cited source before display.
quote: An independent verifier checks every claim in a brief against its cited source before the brief is shown.

statement: The action service executes an authorized action and records a receipt for it.
quote: The action service executes an authorized action and records a receipt for it.

statement: Western Digital supplies the corpus, data lake access, authorization roles and the quality-system integration decision.
quote: Western Digital supplies the corpus, the data lake access, the authorization roles and the quality-system integration decision.

statement: Slide decks, Confluence known-issue pages and Excel sheets are normalized into one FA case schema.
quote: Slide decks, Confluence known-issue pages and Excel sheets are normalized into one FA case schema.

statement: Every normalized case records symptom, signature, failure mode, evidence, disposition and the exact source span of each field.
quote: Every normalized case records symptom, signature, failure mode, evidence items, disposition and the exact source span of each field.

statement: Low-confidence extractions are queued for review and never guessed.
quote: Low-confidence extractions are queued for review instead of being guessed.

statement: Source access control lists travel with every indexed chunk and are enforced at retrieval time.
quote: Source access control lists are copied onto every indexed chunk and are enforced at retrieval time.

statement: Structured build and test facts are read through typed, versioned, access-checked tools over a curated semantic layer.
quote: Structured build and test facts are read through typed, versioned, access-checked tools over a curated semantic layer, not through free-form text-to-SQL.

statement: Typed tools return the build record, test runs, lot recurrence and applicability conditions of a drive.
quote: The typed tools return the build record, the test runs, the lot recurrence and the applicability conditions of a drive.

statement: Western Digital supplies read access to the corpus and the data lake for the pilot product family.
quote: Western Digital supplies read access to the corpus and the data lake for the pilot product family.

statement: Triage of a failed drive yields one state, one next action, ranked candidate modes with applicability, closest prior cases and a receipt.
quote: Triage of a failed drive yields one state, one next action, ranked candidate failure modes with their applicability, the closest prior cases and a receipt.

statement: A case is in exactly one of the states decision required, recommended, unknown or handled.
quote: The state of a case is exactly one of decision required, recommended, unknown or handled.

statement: A failure mode is admitted as known only when every applicability condition holds and no falsifier fires.
quote: A failure mode is admitted as known only when every applicability condition holds and no falsifier fires.

hints.acceptance: On the reference kernel, known_a is admitted ALIVE and known_b_misleading is admitted to its own mode despite structural similarity.

statement: A candidate ranking from a language model or learned ranker never admits a known failure mode by itself.
quote: A candidate ranking from a language model or a learned ranker never admits a known failure mode by itself.

statement: A partially applicable case shows how many applicability conditions hold and names the missing one.
quote: When some applicability conditions are unmet, the case shows how many conditions hold and names the missing one.

statement: Every candidate failure mode carries a stated falsifier before any action is proposed.
quote: Every candidate failure mode carries a stated falsifier before any action is proposed.

statement: A drive between two known clusters receives the discriminating test with the highest expected information gain per station minute.
quote: A drive whose signature lies between two known clusters receives the discriminating test with the highest expected information gain per minute of station time.

statement: A drive outside all known clusters opens a full FA investigation instead of the nearest known mode.
quote: A drive whose signature lies outside all known clusters opens a full FA investigation instead of the nearest known mode.

statement: A drive with missing, stale or conflicting evidence is shown as unknown and receives no proposed failure mode.
quote: A drive with missing, stale or conflicting evidence is shown as unknown, and no failure mode is proposed for it.

statement: A case admitted as known while an applicability condition is unmet or a falsifier fires falsifies the goal.
quote: The goal is falsified if a case is admitted as known while an applicability condition is unmet or a falsifier fires.

statement: Phase one excludes automatic test scheduling on stations.
quote: Phase one excludes automatic test scheduling on stations.

statement: Phase one excludes root-cause authoring for novel failure modes.
quote: Phase one excludes root-cause authoring for novel failure modes.

statement: The morning brief is a projection of admitted case state and never a separate source of truth.
quote: The morning brief is a projection of admitted case state, never a separate source of truth.

statement: The morning email carries no evidence and its links open the case view with context preserved.
quote: The morning email carries no evidence; its links open the case view inside the assistant with the context preserved.

statement: Every brief claim links a source span and a timestamp, and an uncited claim is removed before display.
quote: Every claim in the brief links to a source span and a timestamp, and an uncited claim is removed before display.

statement: The brief shows access-denied, stale-evidence, pending-action and failed-verification states explicitly.
quote: The brief shows access-denied, stale-evidence, pending-action and failed-verification states explicitly instead of omitting them.

statement: Items handled without the engineer appear with their rule, evidence and a way to reverse them.
quote: Items handled without the engineer appear with the rule, the evidence and a way to reverse them.

statement: A brief showing a claim without a resolvable source span falsifies the goal.
quote: The goal is falsified if a brief shows a claim without a resolvable source span.

statement: Phase one excludes open-ended chat across the corpus.
quote: Phase one excludes open-ended chat across the corpus.

statement: Every write, escalation and novel-mode call requires authorization by a named human.
quote: Every write, every escalation and every novel-mode call requires an authorization by a named human.

statement: The confirmation step states the consequence of each outcome before the engineer commits.
quote: The confirmation step states the consequence of each outcome before the engineer commits.

statement: An authorized action produces a receipt with identity, authority, consequence, replay and standing.
quote: An authorized action produces a receipt with identity, authority, consequence, replay and standing.

statement: Automatic closure applies only when all applicability conditions hold, and one closure in ten is sampled by a human.
quote: Automatic closure applies only when all applicability conditions hold, and one closure in ten is sampled by a human spot-checker.

statement: Quality or manufacturing execution system write-back happens only through the action service and only if Western Digital permits it.
quote: Write-back to the quality or manufacturing execution system happens only through the action service and only if Western Digital permits it.

statement: A consequential action executing without a named human authorization and a receipt falsifies the goal.
quote: The goal is falsified if a consequential action executes without a named human authorization and a receipt.

statement: Phase one excludes supplier-facing corrective action requests.
quote: Phase one excludes supplier-facing corrective action requests.

statement: Phase one excludes live integration with Western Digital systems until Western Digital authorizes it.
quote: Phase one excludes live integration with Western Digital systems until Western Digital authorizes it.

statement: Western Digital supplies who may authorize closure and escalation.
quote: Western Digital supplies who may authorize closure and escalation.

statement: Western Digital decides whether quality-system write-back through an API is allowed in phase one.
quote: Western Digital decides whether quality-system write-back through an API is allowed in phase one.

statement: Closing, reopening or routing a case records the verdict without extra data entry.
quote: Closing, reopening or routing a case records the verdict without extra data entry.

statement: A reopened automatic closure suspends the rule that produced it.
quote: A reopened automatic closure suspends the rule that produced it.

statement: A verified novel-mode investigation becomes reusable experience so an equivalent later case routes as known.
quote: A verified novel-mode investigation becomes reusable experience, so an equivalent later case routes as known.

hints.acceptance: On the reference kernel, novel_x is UNKNOWN, a verified receipt compiles MachineExperience, and novel_x_replay routes ALIVE with fewer exploratory steps.

statement: The reranker is retrained weekly and proposed rules are reviewed monthly.
quote: The reranker is retrained weekly and proposed rules are reviewed monthly.

statement: Mean time to resolution of known failure modes is measured against a baseline from a four-week shadow period.
quote: The mean time to resolution of known failure modes is measured against a baseline recorded during a four-week shadow period.

statement: The pilot reports top-three mode agreement with final disposition, automatic-closure reopen rate and uncited claims shown.
quote: The pilot reports top-three failure-mode agreement with the final disposition, the reopen rate of automatic closures and the number of uncited claims shown.

statement: Metric targets stay pending until Western Digital supplies the baseline and its measurement method.
quote: Targets for these metrics stay pending until Western Digital supplies the baseline and its measurement method.

statement: Phase one stops when a golden set replays blind through triage, the shadow period yields a baseline and every falsifier was exercised without firing.
quote: Phase one stops when a golden set of closed cases replays blind through triage, the shadow period has produced a baseline, and every falsifier above has been exercised without firing.

statement: Western Digital supplies the current mean time to resolution by failure mode and its measurement method.
quote: Western Digital supplies the current mean time to resolution by failure mode and how it is measured.

statement: Work discovered during the pilot that falsifies no WBPR proposition enters a successor goal.
quote: Work discovered during the pilot that falsifies no proposition of this WBPR enters a successor goal.

statement: Every proposal claim is classified as supplied, publicly observable, architectural inference or Western Digital dependent unknown.
quote: Every claim in a proposal derived from this WBPR is classified as supplied, publicly observable, architectural inference or dependent on an unknown Western Digital input.

hints.acceptance: python3 scripts/sjira/wd_claims.py check --ledger docs/sjira/v26.9.23/wd-fa/claims.ttl --proposal docs/sjira/v26.9.23/wd-fa/proposal.md exits 0.
hints.falsifier: A claim-bearing proposal sentence has no ledger class, or two classes.

statement: An unsupplied Western Digital internal fact stays typed unknown and is never manufactured.
quote: A Western Digital internal fact that was not supplied stays typed unknown and is never manufactured.

statement: An observed proof is cited only with a receipt the fleet receipt validator admits.
quote: An observed proof is cited only with a receipt that the fleet receipt validator admits.

statement: An unsupplied Western Digital fact appearing in a proposal as anything other than unknown falsifies the goal.
quote: The goal is falsified if an unsupplied Western Digital fact appears in a proposal as anything other than unknown.
